# Mutable Instruments notice (test room only)

The /test build's synth uses two macro-oscillators modelled on Mutable Instruments **Plaits**, with two processor
types modelled on **Rings** and **Warps**. The models were written for this project from the published designs and
panel meanings of those modules; they are not a line-for-line port of the firmware and will not sound identical.

The original firmware is by Emilie Gillet and is published under the MIT licence:
